verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an accounting SaaS like Moneybird, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no retention settings, data-deletion endpoints or account-deletion capability. The contacts API is described only as get, create and update. OAuth token revocation ends an application's access, which is an adjacent control and not data retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
